errors.text_span: The orange line labeled "SepLLM (n=64)" closely tracks the Vanilla line throughout training, starting near 3.4 and ending at approximately 2.52. The green line labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H)" behaves very similarly to the orange line, ending at approximately 2.52 as well. The red line labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" also follows a nearly identical trajectory to the Vanilla, orange, and green lines, ending at approximately 2.51–2.52.
